description: Build a reusable component library by moving COMPs to/from .tox files on disk. 'save' uses a deferred, verified same-directory temporary export and refuses overwrite by default; set overwrite_policy='ask' for native Overwrite/Keep consent. 'load' keeps its legacy behavior and reads file_path into parent_path. Paths are on the machine running TouchDesigner.

action.description: save a COMP to a .tox file, or load a .tox into the project.

comp_path.description: (save) The COMP to save as a reusable .tox component.

confirmation_timeout_ms.description: (save) Bounded wait for native overwrite consent.

create_folders.description: (save) Create the parent folders if they do not exist.

idempotency_key.description: (save) Opaque retry key for response-loss recovery.

linked.description: (load) Create a live-linked instance (externaltox) that re-reads the file on change, instead of an independent copy.

name.description: (load, linked) Name for the linked COMP; defaults to the file name.

operation_timeout_ms.description: (save) Bounded polling deadline for the deferred export job.

overwrite_policy.description: (save) Refuse an existing target, or ask through the native TouchDesigner broker before overwrite.

parent_path.description: (load) COMP to place the loaded component inside.

name: manage_component
title: Save / load component (.tox)
